tagline: KMZ数码单反相机，1955 年发布
description: KMZ于1955年推出的数码单反相机。配备Industar-50 1:3.5 F=5 cm。快门速度** Cloth focal-plane shutter. 1/25 - 1/500 second plus 'B' on early examples; 1/30 - 1/500 second plus 'B' later. Cable release socket in shutter release button. No delayed action.。使用24x36 mm on standard 135 cartridge film。

specs.快门: ** Cloth focal-plane shutter. 1/25 - 1/500 second plus 'B' on early examples; 1/30 - 1/500 second plus 'B' later. Cable release socket in shutter release button. No delayed action.
specs.取景器: Pentaprism viewfinder with ground glass focusing screen. No prismatic focusing aids. High magnification, low coverage (aprox. 80% of lens field).
specs.英文简介: The Zenit CThe 'C' is a Cyrillic 'S', and stands for "sinkhronizirovannyy," "synchronized," referring to the shutter's being synchronised for flash.
